categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: agricultural machinery manufacturing and aerospace components manufacturing. The agricultural machinery segment focuses on mid-to-high-end farm and livestock machinery, including self-propelled corn harvesters and forage harvesters. The aerospace segment involves manufacturing aircraft structural parts, engine components, and aerospace-related equipment, serving military and civilian aerospace markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as CNC machining, hot creep forming, laser penetration welding, and special surface treatment processes. It integrates new materials and processes including titanium alloys, high-temperature alloys, and additive manufacturing for aerospace parts. Production methods include order-based custom manufacturing with both customer-supplied and self-procured materials, and assembly and heat treatment capabilities to extend the value chain.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include military aircraft manufacturers, civil aviation companies, aerospace engine producers, and agricultural end-users such as farmers and agricultural machinery dealers. The aerospace segment serves defense, commercial aviation, low-altitude economy, commercial space, nuclear, and marine industries. The agricultural segment primarily serves domestic farmers and agricultural enterprises in major corn-producing regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Xinjiang, Sichuan, Beijing, Shaanxi, Liaoning, and other provinces. Major sales markets include Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia, Heilongjiang, Jilin, Liaoning, and Beijing. It also has subsidiaries and operations in other provinces such as Guizhou and Shandong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures key components and assemblies for aerospace and agricultural machinery, providing integrated processing, assembly, and surface treatment services. It sources specialized raw materials and consumables, and delivers finished parts and machinery to OEMs and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing full-process and component assembly capabilities, expanding special surface treatment production lines, and increasing equipment utilization. The company focuses on aerospace military and commercial markets, low-altitude economy, commercial space, and nuclear fusion sectors. R&D emphasizes intelligent agricultural machinery, new energy machinery, additive manufacturing, and advanced aerospace materials and processes, supported by national key projects and patents.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of agricultural machinery and aerospace components. Sales are conducted via direct orders and dealer networks, with customized manufacturing based on client specifications. The company also earns income from government subsidies and occasional asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading private enterprise in China's aerospace component manufacturing with broad product coverage and advanced technology. It competes with other domestic aerospace and agricultural machinery manufacturers, leveraging its integrated manufacturing capabilities and diversified product portfolio. It holds a strong position in military aerospace supply chains and is expanding into emerging markets like commercial space and low-altitude economy.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately 665 million RMB, a 44% decline from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 319 million RMB. The agricultural machinery segment accounted for 80% of revenue, aerospace 20%. The company faces financial challenges including high debt levels and negative net assets, but is implementing measures to improve cash flow and operational efficiency. R&D investment remains significant at nearly 7% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, high-reliability aerospace components with advanced manufacturing technologies and comprehensive process integration. In agricultural machinery, it offers domestically developed, intelligent, and high-performance equipment that replaces imports and meets specific regional needs. Its value proposition includes technical innovation, quality assurance, diversified product lines, and expanding service capabilities in emerging aerospace and agricultural markets.
